Keylane - insurance software

Purpose

I build and modernise policy-administration software for European insurers and intermediaries, spanning Java services, relational databases and Angular interfaces.

Approach

Own features from solution analysis through implementation, database changes, automated testing and release.

Status

Professional work since 2019. Currently leading ongoing SOAP-to-REST modernisation; the replacement is still in development.

  • Java
  • Angular
  • REST APIs
  • SOAP
  • OpenAPI
  • SQL
  • Liquibase

API modernisation and compatibility

I lead the ongoing replacement of a long-standing SOAP policy-data service with REST, covering solution analysis, resource and response models, authorisation, error handling and test strategy. I document API contracts in OpenAPI and deliver the migration in increments.

I also maintain versioned integrations and have retired older service versions in stages, planning changes around existing consumers.

Authorisation and business workflows

I implement role-based authorisation for policy operations and administrative settings. Authentication, authorisation and compatibility are considered alongside business behaviour and automated checks.

Explore a fictional access decision ↗

My feature work includes policy renewals, batch processing, contract lifecycle rules and customer communications.

Angular and legacy migration

I build Angular screens and migrate legacy workflows in stages, preserving permissions and user journeys before retiring older routes. I also maintain JSP and AngularJS code where changes still depend on those layers.

Database changes and investigation

I deliver schema and data migrations with Liquibase alongside application changes. Query access-path analysis and proposed index changes support decisions about batch and screen performance.

When defects span code, data and APIs, I reproduce the behaviour, trace the cause and add tests for the affected path.

Test modernisation

I led work to replace a slow legacy regression suite with faster integration tests. My testing spans JUnit unit tests, database-backed and full-stack integration tests, and Playwright browser tests, including coverage for renewals and migrated screens.

Technical ownership and developer tooling

I turn business requests into requirements and acceptance criteria, make solution decisions, review code and support demonstrations and sign-off with product owners and testers. I write functional descriptions in English and Dutch, technical notes and release documentation.

I contributed to internal AI-assisted developer tooling, including coding-assistant plugins and bug-triage workflows, with testing and human review before merge.
